text:
amelia: Following up from today's All Hands pricing segment. Creating a compact thread for quick answers on rate limits, credits, and demo quotas.

natalie: do trial credits show expiry in the Console and in emails? customers keep asking.

leo: yes. Trial credits currently expire after 90 days. Console billing page shows expiry and we send a reminder email at 14 days and 3 days before expiry.

sam: sandbox vs paid keys? limits differ?

raj: sandbox keys = lower defaults: 20 rps, 4 concurrent, 10k monthly token allotment, no soft-burst. Paid hosted keys default to 60 rps, 16 concurrent with soft-burst when capacity allows.

natalie: can credits be used to bypass rate limits?

raj: no. Credits are billing units only. Rate limits protect stability. Exceptions are negotiated burst allowances in enterprise contracts.

olivia: quickest path for demo bursts?

raj: file a support ticket titled "demo-boost" with keys and window. Ops can provision temporary elevated concurrency and a capped spend. Internal SEs have auto-allow up to 120 rps for 2 hours.

leo: action: add explicit expiry column to billing CSV and a small credits->tokens calculator in the Billing UI (ETA: May).

deploy-bot: Billing feature flag for credits UI will start rolling out on 2026-05-12 to 25% of accounts.

amelia: great, will follow up after these items land.
